verdict.rationale: The integrations directory claims ClickUp can "sync … issues between GitHub and ClickUp" and can link GitLab issues with ClickUp tasks. That points to repo issue-tracker sync, but these are one-line marketing blurbs that never confirm true two-way behavior. GitLab is described only as "linking," and the Bitbucket entry covers only commits, branches and PRs, not issues. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bi-directional issue/task sync (status, field and comment mapping, conflict handling), in-depth setup docs, independent or hands-on corroboration that the sync avoids duplicated data.
